name: Roost
description: Native Mac mail app for many inboxes: several Gmails, Outlook, iCloud, Zoho, Yandex and any IMAP in one keyboard-first window. Mail stays on your Mac.
terms: No code. One licence: 3 Macs, every future update, no subscription. After Dec 1: $29 for the first 100 licences, then $49. macOS 15+.
